caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical metallic object placed centrally on a plain, beige background. The object is rendered with shades of brown, gray, and metallic tones, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The top surface features a recessed, circular depression at the center, surrounded by another smaller hole and a few tiny, evenly spaced indentations. On the curved side of the cylinder, there is an oval-shaped label with dark text that reads “G. Crolius / Manhattan Wells / New York.” The entire drawing is bordered by two rectangular frames, one thin and black, the other thicker and lighter in color. The lower right corner of the inner frame contains a signature reading "H. Fumagalli.”
title: Inkwell
